title: Jiang–Su Embeddings in Character-Free Central Sequence Algebras
exact_target: If $F(A)$ has no characters, must it contain a unital copy of $\mathcal Z$? Does $\mathcal Z$ embed unitally into $\bigotimes_{n=1}^{\infty}D$ for every unital $C^*$-algebra $D$ without characters?
